title: Dialogue. Fear in Investing Doesn't Always Feel Like Fear

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: The episode explores fear in investing and analyzes a specific case study involving Evolution Gaming.
reader_summary.overview: This discussion examines how fear and other psychological biases affect investment decisions. The hosts also review a specific investment case study involving Evolution Gaming to illustrate these concepts. Finally, they consider whether missing out on AppLovin was a mistake.

key_points.text: The episode discusses fear in investing and other psychological biases that impact decision making.

key_points.text: The hosts analyze an investment case study with Evolution Gaming to learn lessons.
The discussion considers whether missing AppLovin was a mistake for investors.
